answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 18741 Country: United Kingdom Title: Please could you confirm the name 'Maseeha' is acceptable for a muslim girl and what does the name mean. Question: Please could you confirm the name 'Maseeha' is acceptable for a muslim girl and what does the name mean. Jazakallah Khair! Answer ID: 18741 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 179/172/B=1431) Maseehah is the feminine form of Maseeh which is the nickname of Sayyidna Isa ? peace be upon him ? who used to cause the dead to be alive as miracle. You can keep the name attributing to the prophet. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
